name: Paper Shakespeare: Modern Warfare
source:
General Caius "Coriolanus" Martius is one of Rome's most feared warriors. So, you know, as this is a war story, that's gonna have a happy ending. As a war story in Shakespeare Times(tm), it will 100% have a happier ending than any other happy ending.
Yes, that's sarcasm.

Enemies are around every corner. Old vendettas lurk in every shadow. War is never over. Navigate Caius through this poorly-drawn (boy, that joke is really overused by now) visual novel of battle, betrayal, and choices that you have to make every so often that may or may not throw the story in a new direction. A direction that Shakespeare never intended. Scary, right? Total Death of the Author right here.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
凯厄斯·“科利奥兰纳斯”·马蒂乌斯将军是罗马最令人畏惧的战士之一。所以，你知道，因为这是一个战争故事，所以会有一个幸福的结局。作为莎士比亚时代的战争故事，它百分百会比任何其他的幸福结局都有一个幸福的结局。
是的，这就是讽刺。

敌人无处不在。每一个阴影中都潜藏着旧仇。战争永远不会结束。带领凯厄斯浏览这部画得糟糕的视觉小说（天哪，这个笑话现在真的被滥用了），讲述了战斗、背叛和你必须经常做出的选择，这些选择可能会也可能不会将故事推向新的方向。这是莎士比亚从未想过的方向。可怕吧？作者的彻底死亡就在这里。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082760/]Steam[/url]]
